name: Beach boardwalk entrance (archway sign + info boards + directional posts)

offset_basis_summary: Beach_Sign, Direction_Pole_Big, Direction_Pole_Small and the two Blue_Cartel info boards all sit in one contiguous band of the 21_Beach sheet (x80-256, y240-304), so all offsets are read directly from sheet_x/sheet_y with origin snapped to (80,240).

pieces.notes: BEACH entrance archway; walk-under is passable despite solid=true framing posts.

variants.board_count: Either info board may be dropped for a lighter entrance; direction posts are interchangeable with sign_direction pointing left/right.

notes: Sheet-relative signage cluster: the archway forms the walk-through gate while the direction posts and map boards read naturally as a boardwalk-entrance kiosk beside it, matching their real adjacency on the 21_Beach contact sheet.
